feeds.title: My So-Called Life Blog
feeds.description: This has always been my attempt to share the way I see while my heart lives in two places at the same time... his world (6,018 miles away) and mine. Making an adventure out of my LDR journey while I wait to close the distance forever.

feeds.title: From UK to the Philippines with Love
feeds.description: Get tips and stories related to long distance relationships, gossips, love and much more. From UK to the Philippines with Love is a Long distance relationship blog of an English guy and a Filipino.

feeds.title: Loving From A Distance Blog
feeds.description: Here you will find advice and tips on how to make your relationship survive the distance, a supportive community of fellow long distancers, inspiring pages including true LDR stories, as well as other resources relevant to those in 'geographically challenged' relationships.

feeds.title: LDR Magazine
feeds.description: A positive online community & digital magazine that helps LDR Couples take the distance out of Long Distance Relationships. Here you will find inspirational content, LDR gift ideas, activities & more to help you survive your LDR.

feeds.title: Lasting The Distance
feeds.description: Find advice for long-distance couples, fun things to do together over distance, 100+ gift ideas, inspiring LDR quotes, and more.

feeds.title: Long Distance Dates Blog
feeds.description: We are a long-distance couple who have been planning creative, romantic, and engaging long-distance dates for over 2 years! Follow us to get great ideas for your next date night and see the best ways to stay connected, despite the distance. Our goal is to help LDR Couples have dates that build connection, creativity, and communication.
